correctness.rationale: The r-fold n-gon pyramid has skeleton K_r join C_n (n>=3,r>=1), not a Cartesian product. Fourier decomposition of its Laplacian yields R_AA=2/(n+r) and the apex–rim resistance formula; Foster sum gives r κ_A+n κ_C=1. The cycle eigenvalues λ_j=2−2cos(2πj/n) and weights w_j=n−λ_j satisfy sum w=n(n−3), sum wλ=2n(n−3). For n>=5, positivity of κ_A follows from Jensen strict lower F_n(B/2−2)>2, chord upper F_n(B/2−1)<2 and monotonicity in integer r; rim κ_C>=1/(n+r). Special n=3 complete graph and n=4 modes addressed. Independently evaluated 91 integer (n,r) cases against claimed 2r>=n(n−3)−2. No integer curvature zero, so fixed unit-conductance strict threshold holds for all parameters (not for weighted-existence curvature).
